description: Do not ask for a GitHub PAT in chat. Use an owner-authorized private credential channel, or omit the PAT and use manual provider setup. These legacy schema fields document the underlying operation, not permission to send secrets through MCP. Connect a push webhook so pushes to a custom deployment's tracked Git branch redeploy it. With github_pat (Fine-grained, Repository Webhooks read/write), Impreza installs the GitHub hook and discards the PAT. Without it, the response returns payload_url and a one-time webhook_token to configure in another provider. Keep the token private and use the provider's secret-token/header setting. Only custom deployments with a git_url source are supported. Read impreza_git_webhook_status first; disconnect before rewiring an existing connection.

github_pat.description: Optional GitHub Fine-grained PAT for the one-click flow. Omit for the manual/generic flow.

name: impreza_git_webhook_connect
title: Connect git auto-deploy
